VERDICT.rule: value is claimed iff best_H2 > best_S2

admissibility_rule: PREREG §5.4 -- below 0.95 the comparison is UNMATCHED and no margin is claimed
segments_note: ARM S2 ran in one or more segments; each resumption carried the REMAINING budget, so the segments sum to one matched arm rather than several arms. Same procedure as P-C1's ARM S.
transport_errors_note: A timed-out request buys nothing and is excluded from tokens_spent. P-C1's ARM S recorded 1 transport error in 54 samples; a materially higher rate here is an operational fact about this session's network path, recorded rather than smoothed.
